(def symbol
  "Returns a Symbol with the given namespace and name. Arity-1 works
  on strings, keywords, and vars."
  (fn
    ([name]
     (cond (symbol? name) name
           (string? name) (let [idx (suss.bootstrap/string-index-of name "/")]
                            (if (< idx 1)
                              (symbol nil name)
                              (symbol (suss.bootstrap/string-slice name 0 idx)
                                      (suss.bootstrap/string-slice name (inc idx) (.-length name)))))
           (var? name) (.-sym name)
           (keyword? name) (recur (.-fqn name))
           :else (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "no conversion to symbol"))))
    ([ns name]
     (let [sym-str (if-not (nil? ns) (str_ ns "/" name) name)]
       (Symbol. ns name sym-str nil nil)))))
